name: a2-browser-suite
title: Real-browser sync suite, consecutive runs (flakiness check)

git.commit_note: branch main has no commits yet; numbers come from the uncommitted working tree

environment.docker_desktop_note: Docker Desktop on Windows: containers run in the WSL2 VM; Redis/Postgres/Qdrant and sandboxes cross the Windows<->VM boundary

conditions.what: tests/playwright browser-*.spec.ts: Chromium contexts on /e2e/editor (Monaco + y-monaco), real sync nodes
conditions.topology: 2 sync nodes + Node LB (node-kill spec: its own private pair + LB), API for cross-node Accept, NEXT_PUBLIC_E2E=1 production build

protocol: suite run back to back; no warm-up (pass/fail check); latency spec reports 30 samples per run
